scope: provider-neutral hosted runtime contract, not wire schema

interfaces.name: SecretStoreIdentity + sameSecretStoreIdentity
interfaces.rule: One stable identity for signer, remint, preflight and delivery reload; no alternate store fallback

interfaces.name: getSpaceAuth + remintDaemonCreds
interfaces.rule: Stripped auth/auth.json remains the supported per-space view; same-store signer/read/write and candidate preflight

interfaces.name: holdDaemonRenewalLease + reloadStoreIdentity
interfaces.rule: Lease and store identity are both required; unknown owner writes nothing

interfaces.name: openAuthAuthorityPlane + AuthAuthorityPlane.fenced/close
interfaces.rule: Mint/callout refuse after fence; convert outer runAuthService process lifetime to context handle

interfaces.name: runDelivery
interfaces.rule: Extract explicit start/readiness/drain/close without changing CLI runner

interfaces.name: ManagerOptions.remoteAuthority + Manager.start/stop
interfaces.rule: Reuse five stable identities and current epgate; signerless pooled mode has no local PTY

interfaces.name: RemoteManagerAuthorityRequest + parseRemoteManagerAuthorityRequest
interfaces.rule: Add only closed standing-bundle and run-driver operations, never generic signing or caller-selected grants

interfaces.name: renewStandingBundle
interfaces.rule: Validate, preflight and stage the whole family before adoption; preserve last-good and cleanup debt

interfaces.name: renewRunDriver
requestBinding: same driver and mediator public nkeys
interfaces.rule: Only active attempt may renew; no authority widening or takeover by renewal

interfaces.name: Host context lifecycle state/handle
interfaces.rule: Explicit inputs and start/readiness/drain/close, context-local failure and no process-global exit

interfaces.name: Slot supervisor + peer-uid credential adapter
interfaces.rule: Two worker types, distinct role/group uid views; assigned account/kind allowlist, bounded queues, per-context restart

interfaces.name: Durable assignment + cell mapping + manifest
interfaces.rule: Single writer, atomic durable render, no authority from manifest alone; immutable account key on all caches

interfaces.name: OS role/group projection + immutable release/edge routes
interfaces.rule: system-level distinct uids and group views; source/ABI provenance, same-origin second-cell route, no target build

G: Cloud backend runtime composition and units.ts activation
Cloud peer-uid adapter and OS-isolation enforcement
measured static caps and fair bounded queues
H: Cloud backend persisted assignment and cell mapping
interface patches offered to G for G-owned composition
J: system-level unit templates and uid/view projection
immutable artifact/ABI checks and forward recovery

handoffRules: E and F coordinate shared auth service integration; F owns schema, E owns outer service wrapper
C owns standing-connection health module; E owns delivery.ts wiring
D owns membership scan changes, not E
G alone owns Cloud runtime activation; H/J supply their own mapping/deploy interfaces
Avoid unrelated manager persona-ref/preserve-state and ps-row seams
activationRules: Group maximum 16 accounts is a trust ceiling, not measured capacity
Per-slot account/agent/queue caps are measured by G with A's native harness
Unknown authority or ownership blocks context readiness
No local PTY/custodial execution from pooled control
Backend outage permits restart only from a complete committed manifest
One delivery lease per space and duty-specific manager/session/goal/run fences
Observer/evictor renewal remains privileged system rotation; raw KICK is shared-cell availability residual

nativeMatrix.positive: assigned account route and message accepted in both cells
nativeMatrix.negative: wrong cell/slot/store/account, same actor collision and same-slug recreation refused

nativeMatrix.positive: assigned scoped adapter read and live renewal
nativeMatrix.negative: wrong peer uid/kind/identity, cross-group/root seed read, context write and local PTY refused
nativeMatrix.mutation: skip uid check; allow local PTY

nativeMatrix.positive: successor recovers after proven expiration and existing barriers
nativeMatrix.negative: old holder write or mint after handoff/epoch/fence refused

nativeMatrix.positive: all standing and per-run credentials renew and adopt on real broker
nativeMatrix.negative: unproven candidate does not clobber last-good, expired unknown authority unavailable

nativeMatrix.positive: committed-manifest restart without backend, sibling serves after context fault
nativeMatrix.negative: partial manifest, lost reply duplicate, queue overflow or repeated fatal restart visibly refused
